title: Kenworth T604 Custom Built Hi-Tensile Polished Aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar #93
description: Kenworth T604 FUPS compliant hi-tensile aluminium Road Train Bullbar, 88 diameter pipe, Cow Catcher with 5 small uprights to base of Bullbar on extended main box uprights. Outer side contour plates. Reversible Long Vehicle/Road Train signs, Indicator repeaters and daytime running lights in outer uprights. Additional pipe above headlights and in front of the grill for extra protection. 38mm tow pin in the hi-tensile aluminium mounting plate. Reversable Road Train Signs on 5mm aluminium plate. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
